ideas.topic: 一个分子从散原子一步步搭成完整骨架的连续过程(standard·深空biotech·1280x800): 散原子(C/H/O球)→碳伸4只手成键(甲烷CH4,碳四价4/4)→碳连碳成链(zig-zag链+支链)→链两头牵成六边形环→苯环6碳电子(紫QUERY)绕整圈转发光=芳香环。同一组原子球贯穿全程帧间lerp 500ms。HUD骨架小报告随阶段累加(原子/键/环/含芳香环)呼应本节产物。自动播放只langBtn可交互。

labxchange_results.title: Chemical Bonding
labxchange_results.description: Why do atoms react with some elements but not others, and why do they form compounds with such different properties? One of the reasons is the bonds that they form. This pathway provides resources relating to the reasons that atoms bond, and the three different types of bonds that form between atoms: covalent, ionic and metallic.
subject_tags: Chemistry:Molecular and Ionic Compound Structure and Properties
learning_objectives: Name the different ypes of chemical bonds that occur between atoms.
Identify the type of bond that forms based on the electronegativity of the atoms.
Describe how electrons are shared by atoms in a covalent bond.
Describe how electrons are transferred between atoms in an ionic bond.
Explain how metal atoms form a loose arrangement via metallic bonding.

labxchange_results.title: The Chemical Level of Organization
labxchange_results.description: This pathway provides an in-depth look at elements & atoms: the building blocks of matter, chemical bonds, chemical reactions, inorganic compounds essential to human functioning, and organic compounds essential to human functioning. The pathway also provides vocabulary support for these topics, as well as opportunities for learners to self-assess their understanding by analyzing figures and answering questions.
subject_tags: Chemistry:Molecular and Ionic Compound Structure and Properties
learning_objectives: Describe the fundamental composition of matter.
Identify the four most abundant elements in the body.
Explain the relationship between an atom’s number of electrons and its relative stability.
Compare/contrast between ionic bonds, covalent bonds, and hydrogen bonds.
Explain how energy is invested, stored, and released via chemical reactions, particularly those reactions that are critical to life.
Explain the importance of the inorganic compounds that contribute to life, such as water, salts, acids, and bases.

Compare/contrast the four important classes of organic (carbon-based) compounds—proteins, carbohydrates, lipids and nucleic acids—according to their composition and functional importance to human life.

labxchange_results.title: Exploring Molecules in 3D: An Introduction to VSEPR Theory
labxchange_results.description: Uncover the principles of molecular geometry with the VSEPR model, exploring how electron repulsion shapes 3D molecules. Predict molecular structures, bond angles, and hybridization, including linear, trigonal planar, and tetrahedral geometries.
learning_objectives: By the end of this pathway, you will be able to predict the shapes of molecules using the Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR) model, identifying geometries such as linear, trigonal planar, tetrahedral, and octahedral.
Explain how bonding and lone pairs of electrons affect molecular geometry and bond angles in 3D structures.
Identify bond angles and hybridization states of central atoms in molecules, demonstrating the relationship between electron domains and geometry.
Distinguish between electron domain geometry and molecular geometry, providing examples of each in real-world molecules.
Utilize interactive simulations to model molecular shapes and analyze how adding bonds or lone pairs alters geometry.
Describe how electron pair repulsions influence molecular shapes, using examples like ammonia and water to demonstrate the effects of lone pairs.

exercises.question: 一个分子，说到底是由什么搭成的？
options: 最小的积木——原子——用化学键(原子伸出的「手」)手拉手连成的骨架
一整块再也分不开、没有内部结构的东西
几滴水黏在一起
一团看不出形状的雾
exercises.explanation: 分子 = 原子(最小积木) + 化学键(原子伸出来拉住别人的「手」) + 骨架(连出来的整个形状)。把这三块搞懂，就懂机器读分子时在读什么了。

exercises.question: 关于碳，最要牢牢记住的一件事是什么？
options: 碳永远伸出 4 只手去拉住别人，一只都不肯空着（碳四价），所以是搭骨架的主力
碳永远只伸 1 只手
碳从来不和别的碳连
碳的手数每个分子里都不一样
exercises.explanation: 碳四价 = 碳永远形成 4 根键、一只手都不空着。手多又能跟另一个碳手拉手，所以碳能搭出最复杂的骨架，是生命和药里分子骨架的主力。

exercises.question: 单键、双键、三键的区别是什么？
options: 共用电子对的数量不同：单键 1 对(画 1 线)、双键 2 对(画 2 线)、三键 3 对(画 3 线)，键越多抱得越紧
只是颜色不一样
长度完全相同只是名字不同
只有金属里才分单双三键
exercises.explanation: 键就是原子伸出来拉住别人的「手」：一只手是单键、两只手是双键、三只手是三键，对应共用 1、2、3 对电子。手越多两个原子抱得越紧、靠得越近。

exercises.question: 分子骨架的三种基本形状是什么？
options: 链(碳一个接一个连成一串)、支链(链上分出叉)、环(链的两头牵到一起围成圈)
圆形、方形、三角形
大、中、小
红、绿、蓝
exercises.explanation: 碳能彼此手拉手：连成一串是链，链上分叉是支链，两头牵到一起围成圈是环。这就是骨架的三种基本形状，都是碳搭出来的。

exercises.question: 苯环(一种芳香环)为什么特别稳？读骨架时为什么要单独看「含不含芳香环」？
options: 环上的电子绕着整个圈一起转、一起分享(离域)，把负担平摊给六个碳所以特别稳；芳香环在药物分子里到处都是，对分子脾气影响很大
因为它最大最重
因为它含氧
因为芳香环没什么用，只是顺便看看
exercises.explanation: 苯环上的电子不固定在某两个碳之间，而是绕整圈共享——就像一把筷子比一根筷子难折，平摊负担让整个圈格外稳。芳香环是药物骨架里极常见的一块「铁打的积木」，所以骨架报告要单独列它。

options: 一份用 RDKit 读出来的分子骨架小报告：每个真分子的原子数、键、环、是否含芳香环
懂了原子是什么就够了，不用做东西
一张手画的概念图
背下来所有化学式
